rationale: Ground truth is nearly empty (approval + one already-resolved suggestion baked into the diff), so recall is trivially near-full for both. Both independently found the same strongest issue (the identical TOCTOU race unfixed in diffusion_engine.py) and the same sharp catch (2 of 3 new regression tests don't actually gate the regression since daemon-thread exceptions don't fail pytest), giving comparable precision. X presents tighter, more actionable findings with concrete diffs and a clear prioritized verdict, while Y's report is padded with several near-duplicate 'claim-refuted' bullets restating the same test-gating point and denser, harder-to-scan evidence blocks, slightly hurting its actionability despite Y's genuinely useful CI-marker investigation.
